What You'll Do Architect and develop secure, scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js, with a strong eye on system design, performance, and reliability Lead the design and development of intuitive mobile and web interfaces in Flutter and React.js, with a consistent experience across platforms Own architecture decisions for one or more product modules end to end, balancing scalability, maintainability, and time-to-market Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines that streamline development and deployment Own app deployment to the Play Store and App Store, keeping releases compliant and shipping frequently Design and integrate database and data-flow architecture that supports real-time, sensor-driven applications Set and enforce testing standards, including automated testing within the CI/CD pipeline, to keep quality high across releases Mentor SDE-1 and SDE-2 engineers, review code, and raise the engineering bar across the team Work in an agile environment with cross-functional teams — sprint planning, estimation, and delivery included You Might Be a Fit If… You have a B.Tech in Computer Science or related field from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, or equivalent) — mandatory You have 7+ years of full stack experience managing production systems at scale You have strong proficiency in backend languages (Go, Python, Node.js) and frontend frameworks (Flutter, React.js) You have proven experience deploying and maintaining applications directly on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store You have hands-on expertise designing CI/CD pipelines and a solid grounding in database design and management You're familiar with Agile methodologies, with a track record of leading or mentoring engineers Bonus: experience with IoT technologies and connected device ecosystems Bonus: familiarity with cloud platforms and API integration Bonus: prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling product environment Bonus: strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Work Location: In person Pay: Up to ₹3,900,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
